goal: Nutzerrelevante Einstiegstexte klar von technischen Audit- und Entwicklerdokumenten trennen und Repository-Hygiene lesbar vorbereiten, ohne Produktcode oder eingefrorene Bereiche zu verändern
tests_required: changed paths remain documentation/iteration metadata only
README links point to existing repository files
no product, database, schema, repository or frozen-core file changes
documentation structure remains readable without developer knowledge
tests_explicitly_not_run: product test suite because no product code changes
database regressions because no database path changes
UI tests because no runtime UI changes
risks: historical developer records must not be rewritten as current user documentation
repository cleanup must not delete branches before merge/ahead status is proven
non_changes: no schema, migration, SQLite, repository or CatalogService changes
no runtime or UI code changes
no branch deletion in this iteration without separate proof
expected_side_effects: newcomers can distinguish current user information from developer evidence
repository cleanup candidates can be reviewed separately without destructive changes

guide_delta.summary: README und eine kurze Einstiegsseite erklären den bestätigten Projektstand ohne Entwicklerwissen; technische Audit-Dokumente bleiben unverändert.
